build_densepose_filter: build a DensePoseDataFilter instance from a Detectron2 CfgNode to filter training proposals
run_filter_proposals: run the DensePoseDataFilter call method to filter proposals with targets for DensePose training
review_iou_threshold: review the DensePoseDataFilter iou_threshold configuration used to match GT boxes against proposal boxes
test_keep_masks: test the DensePoseDataFilter keep_masks option to include coarse segmentation trained by masks
refactor_selected_indices: refactor the DensePoseDataFilter selected_indices logic to filter targets without suitable DensePose or mask annotations
